# An invoice whose grouped payment holds a split line under its `Transaction`.
#
# A `Transaction "..."` line under a payment gives the transaction, and the
# `PaymentSplit` lines under it give the splits of that transaction the
# payment applies. A split line written there, `Assets:Bank 100.00 CAD`, is
# neither: nothing reads it.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal when the file is read, giving the line.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_line_under_a_payments_transaction_is_refused.py.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-G"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-G"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-10
		amount: 100
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		Transaction "4c5d6e7f8a9b0c5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b"
			Assets:Bank 100.00 CAD
			PaymentSplit "5d6e7f8a9b0c5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c"
